nativeCases: Eight configured stable IDs produce eight tracked mission vehicles from two source agencies; dynamic vehicle rows and snapshots agree. Add a ninth catalog record without code changes and verify load/UI; disabled allocation stays unavailable. Decorative clones do not count.
Request at least three vehicles before first arrival; inspect simultaneous independent road progression and distinct return states via actual UI callbacks and Unity snapshots
Both source agencies complete directed outbound and independent return paths to their own base; request one vehicle while another is returning
First and second fire vehicles both arrive; exactly one owns fire-1, the second remains visible standby; wrong-capability assignment and busy takeover reject
Complete onsite solver ACK with assigned vehicle provenance, release crew, return first vehicle, assign standby vehicle, and execute another onsite task
Reject duplicate vehicle request, missing route/prefab, unknown vehicle/slot, insufficient crew capacity and returning-before-release with visible Korean reasons
Paused and failed-solver states freeze travel; reset restores every configured vehicle to its own base with no stale crew owners
Building-height receipts prove both 200m source tags survived generation; station footprint and restored facade captures correspond to attributed manifest
Inspect actual rendered city and close-up vehicle/station views; one-unit/one-metre, no road/floor clipping, zero world text, readable Korean UI
City view hides station floor controls; entering station interior reveals contextual floors, and returning to city hides them again without disabling agency actions
acceptance.largerStoryGate: Run 1200–1800 seconds continuous accepted simulation with repeated dispatch/onsite/return cycles and recovery. Save/reload must restore mission IDs, route cursor, assignment ownership and request idempotency from an atomic checkpoint associated with the same training session; no duplicated cars or lost busy state. Existing persistence is not presumed to contain fleet state. If absent, leave this gate and whole story IN_PROGRESS explicitly.
acceptance.review: JeV typed review of contract + actual diffs + source authority + native receipts. Root accepts/rejects each finding. A review score, C# parse, or graph existence cannot replace native evidence.

planningScope: One bounded fleet and building restoration increment; no new tickets, no code or Unity execution by planner

fleetContract.capacityMeaning: crewSlots is training crew-assignment capacity, initially one crew per vehicle. It gates assignments and is not firefighter headcount, water capacity, real staffing or patient throughput. No unsupported capacity should be presented as functional.
transitions: Ready -> Requested only for selected vehicle, ready training clock, valid paired routes and available crew capacity
Requested -> EnRoute on accepted simulation time; no wall-clock movement during pause or failed solver
EnRoute -> OnSceneStandby on actual arrival; vehicle arrival alone does not unlock any onsite team
OnSceneStandby -> CrewAssigned by explicit compatible unoccupied team-slot assignment
CrewAssigned -> OnSceneStandby by explicit release only after active onsite work, planned orders and pending commands for that slot are clear
OnSceneStandby -> Returning by explicit vehicle return request; assigned vehicle must release crew first
Returning -> Ready only on reaching its own agency base; departure and return of other vehicles proceed independently

MvpWorkspace.ApplyAgencyContext hides global 1F/2F/3F controls in city mode and exposes them only for station interior context; no city-wide floor meaning. Fleet worker owns this UI edit. fleetContract.rosterRule: Iterate serialized catalog for initialization, snapshots and UI. Never use a literal four/eight vehicle loop or derive identity from team index. Adding or removing a valid catalog row requires no code change. Verify with an additional ninth record and a disabled record.
fleetContract.roleActions: Response vehicles staff compatible empty slots. Relief vehicles can be requested ahead, wait visibly, then replace an idle assigned crew through explicit release and assignment. Crew type filters, availability and source-base travel make choices observable; role labels alone cannot claim different fire/medical physics. Shared 30x20m reference fixture currently supports one external fire crew and one medical crew, stated clearly in UI.

buildingRestoration.criticalHeightFix: Preserve finite positive explicit height values in metres without the universal 192m visual cap. Levels*3 is derived, not measured.
